title: PogSplit overlay message (v1)
description: Messages PogSplit's bridge (EBS) sends to the Twitch overlay. All times are integer milliseconds in one timing method. A 'snapshot' carries the whole run; an 'update' carries what changed; 'offline' says PogSplit stopped. PubSub messages must stay under 5 KB (the bridge targets 4.5 KB); larger snapshots are served by the EBS at GET /v1/channels/{id}/state and GET /v1/runs/{run}, which the overlay calls with the Twitch JWT as Bearer.

ms.description: Milliseconds, or null when there is no time.

time.description: Current timer value (for the active timing method) at the moment the message was sent. The overlay extrapolates from here while phase is Running.

splitIndex.description: Index of the segment currently being run; -1 when not running, equals segment count when ended.

at.description: EBS epoch ms at which 'time' was valid. The overlay extrapolates from it when it knows the EBS clock (HTTP Date header), else from receive time.

cmp.description: Cumulative split time for each entry of 'comparisons', same order.

comparisons.description: Comparison names, e.g. Personal Best, Best Segments, Average Segments. The first one is the streamer's current comparison.

splits.description: This attempt's cumulative split times. Length may be shorter than segments; null means skipped.

seq.description: Monotonic per PogSplit session. A gap makes the overlay refetch /state.

run.description: Content hash of the run (segments, comparisons, golds). When an update's hash differs from the overlay's, it refetches the snapshot.

fx.description: Optional effects since the last message.

splits.description: Full replacement of this attempt's split times.

best.description: Full replacement of best segments, sent when a gold changes them.

run.description: Content hash of the run (segments, comparisons, golds). When an update's hash differs from the overlay's, it refetches the snapshot.

offline.description: Sent by the EBS after 45 s without a heartbeat or when PogSplit closes.
